directions: DIRECTIONS: In this part of the test, you will hear longer conversations. After each conversation, you will hear several questions. The conversations and questions will not be repeated. After you hear a question, read the four possible answers in. your test book and select. The best answer. Remember, you are not allowed to take notes or write in your test book.
